title: VIC storage of accident-damaged motor cars per day (locked yard to under cover), incl GST

scope.classification: Locked storage of an accident damaged motor car following towing from a road accident scene within a controlled area, per day

qualifications.text: This notice comes into operation on 1 July 2026.
All varied charge amounts in this notice are inclusive of GST.
(c) 'motor car' means a motor vehicle less than 4 tonnes GVM (gross vehicle mass) other than a motor cycle.
9.2 Locked storage charge for a motor cycle – under cover […] resulting in a varied charge amount of $10.80 per day.
9.4 Locked storage charge for a motor cycle – in a locked yard […] resulting in a varied charge amount of $6.80 per day.
